title: Targeting
content:
# Targeting

Target X ads by location, interest, Tailored Audience, age, gender and language, and search X's targeting values.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

The targeting fields go on [`POST /v1/ads/create`](/platforms/x-ads/create-ads) and land on the line item as X targeting criteria.

## Targeting fields

| Field | X targeting | Values from |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `countries` | Location | ISO country codes |
| `regions`, `metros`, `cities`, `zips` | Location | `{ "key": "..." }` from targeting search, `dimension=geo` |
| `interests` | Interest | `{ "id": "..." }` from targeting search, `dimension=interest` |
| `audienceInclude`, `audienceExclude` | Custom audience | The X custom audience id of a [Tailored Audience](/platforms/x-ads/audiences) |
| `ageMin`, `ageMax` | Age | Rounded out to the narrowest X age range that covers them |
| `gender` | Gender | `male` or `female`; `all` sends no gender criterion |
| `languages` | Language | Language codes such as `en`; a region suffix (`en_GB`) is dropped |

The geo keys and interest ids are X's own targeting values, so a key from another platform does not work.

`incomeTier`, `customLocations` and `behaviors` are rejected. X removed behavior targeting from its Ads API.

## Age ranges

X targets one age range from a fixed list. A range starts at 13, 18, 21, 25, 35 or 50, and ends at 24, 34, 49 or 54, or runs open-ended.

Zernio picks the narrowest one that covers `ageMin` and `ageMax`. So `ageMin: 20, ageMax: 40` targets 18 to 49.

## Find targeting values

`GET /v1/ads/targeting/search` with the `xads` `accountId` searches X's own catalog ([Search ad targeting](/ad-targeting/search-ad-targeting)). It takes `dimension=geo` or `dimension=interest`.

On `geo`, `geoType` is `country`, `region`, `metro_area`, `city` or `zip`, and `countryCode` narrows the results to one country.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data: search } = await zernio.adtargeting.searchAdTargeting({
  query: { accountId: '66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d', q: 'Austin', dimension: 'geo', geoType: 'city', countryCode: 'US' }
});

const keys = search.results.map((result) => ({ key: result.id }));
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
search = client.ad_targeting.search_ad_targeting(
    account_id="66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d",
    q="Austin",
    dimension="geo",
    geo_type="city",
    country_code="US",
)

keys = [{"key": result["id"]} for result in search["results"]]
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/targeting/search?accountId=66b2e19d8c3f5a7e9d0b1c2d&q=Austin&dimension=geo&geoType=city&countryCode=US" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`):

```json
{
  "results": [
    { "id": "3b77caf94bfc81fe", "name": "Austin", "type": "city", "countryCode": "US" }
  ]
}
```

A geo result's `id` is the X targeting value: send it as `key`. A `country` result's `id` is the ISO code that `countries` takes.

An interest result carries the interest id, with its parent categories in `path`.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `400` with code `invalid_field_value`, `param: "targeting.languages"` | A language X cannot target | Use one of the codes the message lists. |
| `400` with `param: "dimension"` | A search dimension other than `geo` or `interest` | Search `geo` or `interest`. |
| `400` on `incomeTier`, `customLocations` or `behaviors` | X has no slot for them | Remove the field. |
| `501` with code `feature_not_available` | `targeting` sent to `PUT /v1/ads/{adId}` | Create a new ad with the new targeting. |
